verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a TOTP/HOTP one-time-code generator. It has no automation or workflow layer, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation capability. Its sync, QR transfer, and code-editing features are about credential management, not automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
